newsitem.title: GERMANY: CDU lead in Lower Saxony local poll-projections.
newsitem.headline: CDU lead in Lower Saxony local poll-projections.

text.p: The Christian Democrats (CDU) held the lead in local elections in the state of Lower Saxony on Sunday with 40.7 percent of the votes, according to computer projections.

The Social Democrats, who rule the state government, were a close second as they were in the last local elections of 1991. This year they were just 0.1 percent above their 1991 result with 40.3 percent of the vote.
The vote, one of the few to be held in Germany before the next election in 1998, is seen as a barometer for national trends even though voters in such polls usually focus on more local issues.
The Greens had 8.9 percent of the votes while the liberal Free Democrats had 5.1 percent.
